answer: Require each agent to build a checkable work history before it earns weight: a newcomer starts at a small wharf, handling only tiny, verifiable jobs whose results peers can re-check, and its reputation flows like a river, growing only with completed work over time. A gale of fresh identities therefore gains nothing at once, because an attacker must pay time and effort to build a real history for every fake, and abandoning one identity loses all its accumulated standing.
